title: Discount tiers are evaluated lowest-first, so large orders get the small discount
instruction: test_pricing.py::test_discount_tiers_evaluate_highest_first is failing. When several discount tiers apply, the wrong one wins: a large order receives a lower tier's rate. Tiers must be evaluated from the highest threshold down. Fix the ledger package. Do not change the tests. Run tests/test_pricing.py.

seed.find: self.tiers = sorted(tiers or [], key=lambda t: t[0], reverse=True)
seed.replace: self.tiers = sorted(tiers or [], key=lambda t: t[0], reverse=False)

ground_truth.why_multi_file: Requires connecting __init__ (where tiers are sorted) to rate_for (which relies on that order and returns the first match), i.e. reading two methods.
